previously_frozen_outcome: Per additional +100 W/m² ERA5 modeled surface shortwave, original same individual within month×4h astronomical solar-time slope of cos(GPS step travel bearing−solar azimuth); one equal original source study ID mean across 1° gridyears/taxa.
task: Diagnose the observed external source-replication failure without searching for a new confirmatory sign. Preserve the original earlier negative result and the preregistered external negative-direction nonreplication verdict exactly.

full_sample_inference.all_original_source_entries: Include all 48 original source studies, both original source files, all weather/unidentifiable source holds; never substitute a different original source or select by source sign.
full_sample_inference.estimation: Source-equal unweighted arithmetic mean of defined source shortwave slopes within earlier/external sets; the earlier sample's one source mean averages native taxa/gridyears, external sample's one source mean averages top two eligible source gridyears. Study source file is the highest unit, not GPS fixes or animals.
full_sample_inference.primary_descriptive_comparison: Original − external equal-study mean. Within-cohort bootstrap with replacement at original source-study unit (20,000 draws, fixed seed 20261025). CI 2.5–97.5 percentiles and leave-one-original-study-out difference ranges separately.
full_sample_inference.exploratory_label_permutation: Twenty-source pooled study means; shuffle earlier/external labels, holding 10 vs 10, for 20,000 Monte Carlo permutations, deterministic seed +1. Report two-sided |mean_diff| tail probability as an *exchangeability reference only*. The two original source sampling frames are NOT exchangeable random draws from a common ecological world population; never call the probability evidence of causal heterogeneity.
full_sample_inference.pooled_source_mean: Fixed 20 source-equal mean and source-block bootstrap 20,000 draws (descriptive).
full_sample_inference.source_bias_coverage: Report 24 per source sample, 10 identifiable per source sample, 14 no estimates per sample, and no source substitution.

ecological_interpretation.required_all_supported_source_taxa_label: ALL identifiable source-study groups and first native original source names; assign one of birds, mammals, reptiles using explicit frozen mapping only, no paper effects or code search. A prior mixed source with 3 geese is still ONE source unit.
ecological_interpretation.group_source_each: Use exact native taxon names in source row, but if earlier study has mixed source with two valid native taxa of different groups, mark MIXED and exclude ONLY from class-specific descriptive comparison, preserve its all-source contribution.
ecological_interpretation.class_gradient: For each of birds, mammals, reptiles, report N earlier/N external, group mean and signed source counts, and fixed-source bootstrap CI ONLY when >=5 source files in a group. No preregistered guild effect; do not treat taxon groups as mutually matched climates.
ecological_interpretation.latitude_season: For each identifiable source, release coarse N/S hemisphere and source GPS 15-degree absolute-latitude band distribution from previously archived source siteyear contexts. Assign hemisphere if all radiation-identifiable siteyears have same hemisphere, else MIXED. Do not make a p-value for latitude/hemisphere without source independence.
ecological_interpretation.within_source_context_signs: For each original study having >=2 source siteyear contexts with identifiable native source response slopes, report whether signs agree or differ; do not conflate repeated GPS-tagged individuals with biological replicates, and do not count any contextual mean as an independent global study.
ecological_interpretation.completeness: Show study-level source observation support, source selection frame imbalance, unavailable weather observations and taxon classes, including original observed 4-hour solar-time confounding.

no_change_policy: Never rewrite/prune/merge original PR#269/#270/#271 outcomes. Commit separate diagnostic JSON+CSV+source-based interpretative report. If mean contrast not supported, say so; do not reinterpret nonreplication as statistically proven study×climate interaction.
limitation: This is a POST-RESULT diagnostic; any apparent association with taxon class, latitude or cohort can reflect taxonomic sampling, latitudes, movement, calendar, instrument/firmware schedules, coarse 100m wind, sun elevation and ERA5 unversioned retrospective weather. Bootstraps only conditional on observed source-study ID sample.
